title: Attribution record keeping
description: Every work records its source, author, license, and retrieval date in a structured attribution record. Records travel with the work through copies and derivatives. Complete records make compliance automatic; missing records are flagged at ingest. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers structured records per work.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"author": "A. Author", "license": "CC-BY"}, 2: {"author": "", "license": "CC-BY"}, 3: {"author": "B. Writer", "license": "MIT", "source": "archive"}}
rec = CFG[LEVEL]
complete = bool(rec.get("author")) and bool(rec.get("license"))
print("attribution:", rec, "| complete:", complete, "->", "accept" if complete else "FLAG at ingest")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Required-notice generation
description: From attribution records the manager generates compliant copyright notices automatically: the right names, years, and license texts in the required format. Generated notices are reviewed once per template, then produced at scale. Every published derivative carries its notices. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers automatic notice generation from records.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ("A. Author", "2024", "MIT"), 2: ("B. Writer", "2026", "CC-BY-4.0"), 3: ("C. Creator", "2020-2026", "Apache-2.0")}
author, years, lic = CFG[LEVEL]
print("Copyright (c) %s %s. Licensed under %s." % (years, author, lic))
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Usage-requirement enforcement
description: License usage requirements (link-backs, same-license propagation, non-endorsement clauses) are checked before publication. The checker verifies each requirement is satisfied: links resolve, license texts are included, modifications are marked. Publication is blocked until requirements pass. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers checking requirements pre-publication.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"linkback": True, "license_text": True}, 2: {"linkback": False, "license_text": True}, 3: {"linkback": True, "license_text": False}}
reqs = CFG[LEVEL]
ok = all(reqs.values())
print("requirements:", reqs, "| publish:", "ALLOWED" if ok else "BLOCKED: unmet requirements")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Takedown request workflow
description: Takedown requests move through states: received, validated, actioned, and requester-notified. Validation checks the claim (ownership evidence, specific URLs) before any removal. Counter-notices follow the same tracked path. Every transition is timestamped. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers tracked request states.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ["received", "validated", "actioned", "notified"], 2: ["received", "rejected: no evidence"], 3: ["received", "validated"]}
states = CFG[LEVEL]
print("takedown:", " -> ".join(states), "| closed:", states[-1] in ("notified", "rejected: no evidence"))
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Public-domain determination
description: Copyright term rules are applied to determine public-domain status: publication year plus term, with jurisdiction variations. Works clearly in the public domain are marked so; borderline cases are flagged for counsel. Determinations record the rule applied and the inputs. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers term rules per jurisdiction.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 1920, 2: 1935, 3: 2000}
year, NOW, TERM = CFG[LEVEL], 2026, 95
pd = NOW - year >= TERM
print("published:", year, "| public domain:", pd, "->", "mark PD" if pd else "in copyright / counsel review")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.
